magic_items.name: Ice Magic by Zadel Akgrytan
magic_items.description: This obscure tome, written by an orcish mage, teaches spellcasters how to channel the energy of the surrounding environment in order to enhance their ability to cast cold-based spells. The caster, while in the environs of the frozen north, gains an extra 2 spell slots that can be used to cast spells that inflict cold damage (300 gp).

equipment.name: Compass
equipment.description: A small metal compass which points to the magnetic north pole. Using a compass grants advantage on Survival checks to avoid getting lost. A PC with a compass always knows which way is north.

equipment.name: Fur-lined Tent
equipment.description: This heavy tent, which packs away into a surprisingly compact roll, is made from bear fur and will keep you sheltered against even the coldest nights.

equipment.name: Smoke Bomb
equipment.description: Created by an alchemist, a smoke bomb is a small round glass bottle filled with a swirling black cloud. As an action, you can throw a smoke bomb up to 20 ft, shattering it on impact. Thick smoke fills an area in a 5 ft radius around where the smoke bomb shatters: this area is heavily obscured. The smoke disperses after one minute. A strong wind can also disperse the smoke after one round.

equipment.name: Snow glasses
equipment.description: These eye protection devices, crafted from bone, are designed to stop snow blindness when travelling through snowy terrain.

equipment.name: Snowshoes
equipment.description: Frames constructed of wood and sinew can be attached to your boots. Wearing snowshoes allows you to ignore difficult terrain caused by snow.

monsters.name: Oblex Spawn
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this distance), passive Perception 12

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Aversion to Fire
features.description: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d4+3 bludgeoning damage + 1d4 psychic damage.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d10+3 slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 30/50, one target. Hit 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gnoll makes two melee attacks with its spear or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1d6+2 piercing damage, or 1d8+2 when used with two hands in a melee attack.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 1d8+2 piercing damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
